decision.changed_angle: The lead changes from the prior edition's Palantir exposure to Ether after the new, eligible breakout milestone and CoinDesk squeeze-language coverage. PLTR remains a valuation-sensitive smaller position, Apple is explicitly a brief unchanged holding, and gold has a separate bullion-tariff mechanism. Shared names therefore do not reproduce the same investment basket or operating angle.

The continuing crypto exposure earns a full lead here through fresh Ether breakout and squeeze-attention headlines published after its prior appearance boundary, with direct token/fund exposure distinguished from BitMine's treasury premium and issuance risk. The record does not claim a measured retail ranking or use later returns to justify selection.

Fortune's new valuation-scrutiny headline changes the smaller Palantir position from celebrating operating momentum to reassessing the price paid for further growth. The entry stays brief and explicitly resists adding leverage after the run. I removed an unsupported retail-paragraph claim of actual sales acceleration; the attention and valuation argument now rests on the cited own-date headline.

Apple has no new catalyst since its prior appearance. The existing domestic-investment and tariff-relief thesis is retained only as a short, nonlead position with no claim of another earnings event. The paragraph now names the specific investment context, and the exit concerns return on committed capital or weaker demand rather than a fresh price alone.

CoreWeave becomes the lead on its own pending earnings event, direct Stocktwits reporting of analyst and retail hope, and JPMorgan's new preview. That differs from Ether's prior breakout lead. Ether now has a new disclosed treasury-holdings development, gold has a policy clarification removing the tactical tariff premise, and Apple is kept as a brief unchanged position. No pending outcome is rewritten as realised.

The smaller Ether entry advances from the earlier price milestone to a newly disclosed BitMine token balance and a fresh fund-demand comparison. It attributes the corporate holdings to PR Newswire and separates the direct asset from issuance and premium risk in the company wrapper, rather than restating the same full adoption essay.

No new Apple operating or attention catalyst is asserted. The same domestic-investment source supports a short existing-position assessment ahead of the inflation test, with additions conditional on cash economics after the commitment. The text avoids production language about editorial carryovers and remains within the 160-word brief-position gate.

The fresh Stocktwits headline reports the record ETF inflow and Ether leadership, providing a new demand receipt after the prior corporate-treasury update. The smaller entry uses this source-supported attention and fund-demand mechanism, while keeping financing and wrapper risks explicit. It is not selected from later performance or a forced asset quota.

The fresh BitMine fundraising headline makes funding terms the changed angle. The entry compares the token with the distinct treasury-company equity and explains that larger aggregate assets need not improve each shareholder's claim. Its risk and instrument choice therefore differ from the prior fund-inflow receipt, despite a continuing crypto family.
